body_text:
For a function $f:A\to B$ and $y\in B$, the fiber over $y$ is
$f^{-1}[\{y\}]=\{x\in A:f(x)=y\}$. The function is injective
exactly when every fiber has at most one element and surjective
exactly when every fiber is nonempty. Thus fibers measure both
collision and coverage.
